## Self-Hosted Plans
### Free (Self-Hosted)
Host Twenty on your own infrastructure at no cost:
- All Pro CRM features, plus custom roles
- AI runs on your own AI provider keys, without personal AI usage or workspace credits
- Community support via Discord
- Full control over your data
### Organization (Self-Hosted)
For teams who need premium features while self-hosting:
- Everything in Free
- **Premium features**: row-level permissions, SSO and more
- Twenty team support
- No requirement to publish custom code as open-source before distributing
Premium features are only available on the Organization plans (Cloud or Self-Hosted):
- **Custom roles**: Roles beyond Admin and Member, with object and field permissions (on Cloud, Pro (Early) keeps them too; self-hosted instances include them on every plan)
- **Row-level permissions**: Fine-grained access control at the record level
- **SSO integration**: Single Sign-On with your identity provider
- **Audit logs**: Check what each workspace member has been doing
- **Usage limits for members, API keys and apps**: Cap what each of them can spend
- **Custom domain**: Serve your workspace from your own domain (also available on self-hosted instances)
- **Unlimited workspaces**: Create as many workspaces as you want (self-hosted only)
- **Private source code**: No requirement to publish changes to a publicly available repository (self-hosted only)

title: Billing FAQ
snippet:
Pricing
Yes, you can use Twenty for free while self-hosting. You will get access to everything included in the Pro (Cloud) plan, except the support from our core team. Support is accessible via our Discord community.If you want to self-host and need the Premium features (SSO, row-level permissions and more), you can choose the paid Organization (Self-Hosted) license. This also includes support from the Twenty team and removes the requirement to publish custom code as open-source before distributing.
They offer the same premium features. However, a cloud subscription cannot be used for self-hosted deployments. Self-hosted requires an Organization key.
We do not offer free seats. Pricing is per user and each user needs a license to access Twenty.
You can do so under `Settings → Billing → Plans`. Then click on `Switch to Organization`.
You can do so under `Settings → Billing → Plans`. Then click on `Switch to Pro`.
You can do so under `Settings → Billing`. Then click on `Upgrade to yearly`.

The number of credits depends on your billing cycle, not your plan:
- **Monthly subscriptions**: 5 credits per month
- **Yearly subscriptions**: 50 credits per year

title: Billing
snippet:
| Plan | Key Features |
|---|---|
| **Free (Self-Hosted)** | All Pro features, community support |
| **Pro (Cloud)** | Everything apart from the Premium features (SSO, row-level permissions and more), standard support |
| **Organization (Cloud)** | All from Pro + the Premium features (SSO, row-level permissions and more), priority support |
| **Organization (Self-Hosted)** | All from Pro + the Premium features (SSO, row-level permissions and more), Twenty team support, not required to publish your custom code as open-source before distributing |

**Can I use Twenty for free?** Yes! Self-host Twenty and get all Pro features at no cost. **How do I upgrade?** Go to **Settings → Billing** and click **Switch to Organization** or **Switch to Yearly**.
